description: This PHP class 'EmploymentContractDao' is a Data Access Object for managing employment contract entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and save employment contract data, specifically associated with employee numbers, using Doctrine QueryBuilder.

classes.name: EmploymentContractDao
classes.description: A data access object for employment contracts, extending BaseDao, providing methods to get and save employment contract entities.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpContract entity for a given employee number using Doctrine's QueryBuilder.

methods.name: saveEmploymentContract
methods.description: Persists an EmpContract entity to the database.
